intro: I use a flexible and collaborative process to understand the problem, organize complexity, validate decisions, and support the product through implementation.
processNote: THE PROCESS ADAPTS TO THE PRODUCT — NOT THE OTHER WAY AROUND.

steps.description: Align user needs, business goals, existing workflows, and technical constraints before moving into solutions.
Translate insights into user flows, information architecture, and clear priorities for the product experience.
Explore interfaces, prototype key interactions, and review decisions with users, stakeholders, and the product team.
Prepare implementation-ready design, support developers and QA, then refine through UAT and real product feedback.

collaborationText: User needs  ↔  Business goals  ↔  Technical feasibility  ↔  Team feedback
